stories.tz: 疑似警察枪击克拉科夫嫌疑人画面曝光
stories.sz: 现场拍摄的画面似乎记录了警察向克拉科夫嫌疑人开枪的瞬间。

stories.t: Armenia's selective prosecution: A threat to EU relations?
stories.s: While Brussels has refrained from harsh criticism, Armenian civil society has warned of selective justice against opposition figures. Could the EU's pragmatic stance risk repeating past mistakes?
stories.tz: 亚美尼亚的选择性起诉：对欧盟关系的威胁？
stories.sz: 尽管布鲁塞尔克制了严厉批评，但亚美尼亚公民社会已警告称，针对反对派人士的选择性司法存在风险。欧盟的务实立场是否会重蹈覆辙？

stories.t: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
stories.s: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
stories.tz: 美国悬赏2000万美元征集伊朗核计划信息
stories.sz: 唐纳德·特朗普多次提出重新对伊朗核设施实施打击的可能性。

stories.t: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections
stories.s: Near-final results show South Africa's once dominant ANC will see its lowest-ever vote percentage. The party is taking the blame for shoddy municipal services, including water and electricity shortages.
stories.tz: 南非非国大面临地方选举中的最差战绩
stories.sz: 接近最终的计票结果显示，曾经长期占主导地位的南非非国大将迎来有史以来最低的得票率。该党正因水电短缺等糟糕的市政服务而备受指责。

stories.t: Gaza wedding festival sees 250 couples married at the same time
stories.s: A mass wedding for Palestinian brides and grooms has taken place in the rubble-strewn streets of Gaza.
stories.tz: 加沙举行集体婚礼，250对新人同时喜结连理
stories.sz: 巴勒斯坦新郎新娘在加沙布满瓦砾的街道上举行了一场集体婚礼。

stories.t: Andy Burnham wants to get closer to the EU - but he shouldn't expect a smooth ride
stories.s: Laura Kuenssberg talks to government insiders about the prime minister opening the conversation about the UK rejoining the EU.
stories.tz: 安迪·伯恩汉姆希望拉近与欧盟的距离——但过程不会一帆风顺
stories.sz: 劳拉·库恩斯堡就首相开启英国重返欧盟话题一事，与政府内部人士进行了交流。

stories.t: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
stories.s: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.
stories.tz: 被罢免的巴拉圭总统出庭接受检察官讯问
stories.sz: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩尼亚于周五被解除职务并遭软禁。在一家国有背景银行倒闭后，参议院投票通过了他的弹劾案。

stories.t: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
stories.s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.
stories.tz: 意大利外长称其个人数据遭黑客泄露
stories.sz: 总理焦尔吉娅·梅洛尼指责亲俄黑客将相关细节公布在网上。

stories.t: Tens of thousands of tents flooded after heavy rains in Gaza
stories.s: Heavy rain has flooded temporary shelters used by Palestinians displaced during Israel's war with Hamas.
stories.tz: 加沙暴雨过后数万顶帐篷被淹
stories.sz: 暴雨淹没了在以色列与哈马斯战争中流离失所的巴勒斯坦人使用的临时避难所。

stories.t: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
stories.s: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.
stories.tz: 新西兰大选选情胶着，暂无明确胜者
stories.sz: 初步结果显示新西兰国家议会呈现高度分裂状态，组阁谈判可能会持续数周。

stories.t: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
stories.s: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".
stories.tz: 巴尼耶对BBC表示，英国不可能“精挑细选”欧盟单一市场协议
stories.sz: 这位前英国脱欧谈判代表表示，欧盟国家将拒绝英国任何“按需选择”经济规则的企图。

stories.t: Son of Iran's shah receives 'Freedom Prize' in Frankfurt
stories.s: 18,000 people gathered in Frankfurt to show support for Reza Pahlavi, the son of the Iranian monarch ousted in 1979. Factions in the opposition have accused him of not distancing himself from his father's rule.
stories.tz: 伊朗末代国王之子在法兰克福获颁“自由奖”
stories.sz: 1.8万名民众聚集在法兰克福，表达对礼萨·巴列维的支持。他是1979年被推翻的伊朗末代国王之子。反对派中的一些派别指责他未能与其父亲的统治划清界限。

stories.t: After victory in the midterms, what next for US Democrats?
stories.s: Donald Trump's Republican party has lost its majority in both chambers of the US Congress. But the president still has a lot of power — and the Democrats have yet to agree on how best to use theirs.
stories.tz: 美国民主党在中期选举中获胜后将何去何从？
stories.sz: 唐纳德·特朗普所在的共和党已经失去了对美国国会参众两院的控制权。但总统仍然拥有巨大的权力，而民主党人尚未就如何最好地运用自己的权力达成一致。

stories.t: New Zealand election coalition talks will likely take weeks – as it happened
stories.s: This blog is closed, you can read our report on the New Zealand election here Another update here with 8% of the vote counted . National on 31.2%, Labour 28.4%, the Greens 12.9%, Act 11.2%, NZ First 9.6%, Opportunity 5.7% and Te Pāti Māori…
stories.tz: 实时滚动：新西兰大选组阁谈判预计将持续数周
stories.sz: 此直播博客已关闭，您可在此阅读关于新西兰大选的报道。另一则更新显示，在已统计的8%选票中，国家党占31.2%，工党占28.4%，绿党占12.9%，行动党占11.2%，优先党占9.6%，机遇党占5.7%，毛利党……

stories.t: Court rules against Home Office in asylum seeker kidnapping case
stories.s: Department had claimed that being kidnapped for ransom was not exploitation of trafficking victims in case of Syrian man abducted in Libya The court of appeal has rejected claims by the Home Office that being kidnapped for ransom is not…
stories.tz: 法院裁定英国内政部在寻求庇护者绑架案中败诉
stories.sz: 英国内政部此前声称，在利比亚被绑架的叙利亚男子遭勒索绑架不属于贩运受害者的剥削行为。上诉法院驳回了内政部的这一主张……

stories.t: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
stories.s: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
stories.tz: 谈判前夕俄军空袭致乌克兰9人受伤及电网受损
stories.sz: 此次袭击发生乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团下周在阿布扎比参加三方会谈之前。

stories.t: New Zealand election 'too close to call' - so who will be next PM?
stories.s: With the New Zealand election too tight to call, the BBC's Tiffanie Turnbull reports from a Labour Party gathering after an inconclusive night.
stories.tz: 新西兰大选胜负难料——谁将成为下一任总理？
stories.sz: 由于新西兰大选选情胶着、难分胜负，英国广播公司（BBC）记者蒂凡尼·特恩布尔在工党集会现场报道了胶着之夜后的情况。

stories.t: Four things we learned this week about 2028 White House race
stories.s: The seismic Democratic gains in Congress could shape the presidential election, so who had a good night and who's making moves?
stories.tz: 从本周看2028年白宫之争的四个风向标
stories.sz: 民主党在国会中取得的显著进展可能会对总统大选产生影响，究竟谁表现亮眼、谁又在积极布局？

stories.t: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
stories.s: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.
stories.tz: 乌克兰：三方会谈前夕俄罗斯空袭基辅
stories.sz: 空袭击中了基辅地区的一座主要桥梁和能源设施。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基指责莫斯科试图在阿布扎比会谈前夕“迫使”乌克兰“陷入大面积断电”。

stories.t: Amid protests, France's rising debt costs threaten stability
stories.s: France plans to spend an extra €4 billion on education amid nationwide protests. But with public debt mounting and interest costs climbing, how much fiscal room does the government have?
stories.tz: 抗议声中，法国不断攀升的债务成本威胁经济稳定
stories.sz: 在全国性抗议活动期间，法国计划在教育领域额外投入40亿欧元。然而，面对日益增加的公共债务和不断攀升的利息成本，政府究竟还有多少财政腾挪空间？

stories.t: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
stories.s: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.
stories.tz: 德克萨斯州一市长指示警方限制与美国移民和海关执法局合作
stories.sz: 此前，一名移民和海关执法局（ICE）官员在休斯敦开枪打死了一名正驾车上班的男子，引发当地公众长达数月的抗议。

stories.t: US: Giant pandas from China make public debut at Atlanta zoo
stories.s: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang are the first giant pandas to be housed in Zoo Atlanta after a gap of two years.
stories.tz: 美国：来自中国的大熊猫在亚特兰大动物园与公众见面
stories.sz: 在时隔两年之后，“平平”和“福双”成为亚特兰大动物园迎来的首批大熊猫。

stories.t: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
stories.s: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.
stories.tz: 梅根父亲托马斯·马克尔因涉嫌儿童性虐待材料指控被软禁
stories.sz: 在联邦调查局（FBI）搜查了他租用的位于洛杉矶地区的两个储物单元后，这位82岁的老人在佛罗里达州出庭。

stories.t: Strait of Hormuz could reopen as part of Qatari plan for Iran nuclear inspections
stories.s: Trump still considering new assault on Iran nuclear sites – though threats less credible after Vance remarks Qatar, the lead mediator in the US-Iran conflict, is seeking to persuade Tehran to allow UN nuclear weapons inspectors to visit…
stories.tz: 作为卡塔尔伊朗核查计划的一部分，霍尔木兹海峡可能重新开放
stories.sz: 特朗普仍在考虑对伊朗核设施发起新打击——尽管在万斯发表言论后此类威胁的可信度有所降低。作为美伊冲突的主要调解方，卡塔尔正力图说服德黑兰允许联合国核武器视察员访问……

stories.t: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
stories.s: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
stories.tz: 教皇开启拉美之行，称其“健康状况相当不错”
stories.sz: 在接受肺癌手术仅仅三周后，教皇利奥前往乌拉圭访问。

stories.t: US midterm results may help unite Israeli coalition to unseat Netanyahu
stories.s: Democrats’ sweep could urge Israel’s divided opposition to join forces and remove prime minister closely allied with Trump The Democrats’ sweep of Congress may make it easier for Israel’s splintered opposition to overcome deep internal…
stories.tz: 美国中期选举结果或有助于整合以色列执政联盟以驱逐内塔尼亚胡
stories.sz: 民主党的完胜可能促使以色列四分五裂的反对派联合起来，罢免这位与特朗普密切结盟的首相。民主党对国会的横扫，可能使以色列碎片化的反对派更容易克服深层的内部……
